metrics.label: RSI (14)
metrics.gloss: 14-period relative strength index (0–100)

metrics.label: RSI (7)
metrics.gloss: 7-period relative strength index (0–100)

metrics.label: RSI (2)
metrics.gloss: 2-period relative strength index (0–100) — the Connors mean-reversion horizon

metrics.label: MACD histogram
metrics.gloss: MACD histogram — the 12/26 line minus its 9-period signal

metrics.label: MACD line
metrics.gloss: MACD line — the 12-period EMA of close minus the 26-period EMA, in price units

metrics.label: MACD signal
metrics.gloss: MACD signal — the 9-period EMA of the 12/26 MACD line

metrics.label: Stochastic %K
metrics.gloss: stochastic %K (14,1,3)

metrics.label: Stochastic %D
metrics.gloss: stochastic %D — the %K signal line

metrics.label: MFI (14)
metrics.gloss: 14-period money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0–100)

metrics.label: PPO histogram
metrics.gloss: PPO histogram — the 12/26 PPO line minus its 9-period signal, in percent

metrics.label: PPO line
metrics.gloss: PPO line — the 12-period EMA of close minus the 26-period EMA, as a % of the 26-period EMA

metrics.label: PPO signal
metrics.gloss: PPO signal — the 9-period EMA of the 12/26 PPO line, in percent

metrics.label: ROC (9)
metrics.gloss: rate of change vs 9 bars ago (%)

metrics.label: ROC (12)
metrics.gloss: rate of change vs 12 bars ago (%)

metrics.label: ROC (15)
metrics.gloss: rate of change vs 15 bars ago (%)

metrics.label: Squeeze momentum (20)
metrics.gloss: LazyBear's squeeze momentum — the 20-bar linear regression end point of the close's distance from the average of the 20-bar Donchian midline and simple mean, in price units: the direction a TTM squeeze releases

metrics.label: CCI (20)
metrics.gloss: 20-period commodity channel index (±100 reference)

metrics.label: Close change
metrics.gloss: the bar's own change, ((close − open) / open) × 100

metrics.label: Change (5m)
metrics.gloss: the frame price against the open of the 5m bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 5m bar open) / 5m bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

metrics.label: Change (15m)
metrics.gloss: the frame price against the open of the 15m bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 15m bar open) / 15m bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

metrics.label: Change (1h)
metrics.gloss: the frame price against the open of the 1h bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 1h bar open) / 1h bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

metrics.label: Change (4h)
metrics.gloss: the frame price against the open of the 4h bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 4h bar open) / 4h bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

metrics.label: Change (1d)
metrics.gloss: the frame price against the open of the 1d bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 1d bar open) / 1d bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes; the 1d bar opens at the UTC day's 00:00, so this is the change since that open — not a rolling 24h change

metrics.label: WaveTrend
metrics.gloss: the WaveTrend oscillator (10, 21) — the typical price’s distance from its own channel, in mean-deviation units

metrics.label: WaveTrend signal
metrics.gloss: the WaveTrend signal line, a 4-period mean of the oscillator

metrics.label: QQE smoothed RSI
metrics.gloss: the QQE smoothed RSI — a 5-period EMA of RSI(14), on the 0–100 RSI scale

metrics.label: QQE trailing stop
metrics.gloss: the QQE trailing stop, on the same 0–100 scale as the smoothed RSI it brackets

metrics.label: Williams %R (14)
metrics.gloss: 14-period Williams %R — where the close sits in the 14-bar window ending at this bar, 0 at the high and −100 at the low

metrics.label: Stoch RSI %K
metrics.gloss: Stoch RSI %K (14,14,3,3) — where RSI(14) sits in its own 14-bar range, 0–100, smoothed over 3 bars

metrics.label: Stoch RSI %D
metrics.gloss: Stoch RSI %D — the 3-bar mean of Stoch RSI %K, its signal line

studies.label: MACD (12, 26, 9)
studies.gloss: the 12- and 26-period EMAs of close are inputs, not metrics: the MACD line is their difference, the signal is a 9-period EMA of the line, and the histogram is line minus signal. PPO is the same construction in percent of the 26-period EMA (12, 26, 9)

studies.label: Stochastic (14, 1, 3)
studies.gloss: where the close sits in the 14-bar high–low range: %K is that position smoothed over 1 bars, and %D is a 3-bar mean of %K

studies.label: Stoch RSI (3, 3, 14, 14)
studies.gloss: where RSI(14) sits in its own 14-bar range, 0–100: %K is that position smoothed over 3 bars, and %D is a 3-bar mean of %K

studies.label: WaveTrend (10, 21)
studies.gloss: the typical price's distance from its 10-period EMA channel in mean-deviation units, averaged over 21 bars; the signal is a 4-bar mean of that oscillator

studies.label: QQE (14, 5, 4.236)
studies.gloss: RSI (14) smoothed by a 5-period EMA, bracketed by a trailing stop set 4.236 × the smoothed RSI's average range away

studies.label: Multi-timeframe change
studies.gloss: the frame price against the open of each fixed horizon's bar in force at the frame's instant, read live

indicators.label: RSI
indicators.gloss: Wilder's relative strength index of the chosen price over the chosen number of bars, 0 to 100 (TradingView ta.rsi)

indicators.label: MACD (12, 26, 9)
indicators.gloss: the 12- and 26-period EMAs of close are inputs, not metrics: the MACD line is their difference, the signal is a 9-period EMA of the line, and the histogram is line minus signal. PPO is the same construction in percent of the 26-period EMA (12, 26, 9)

indicators.label: Stochastic (14, 1, 3)
indicators.gloss: where the close sits in the 14-bar high–low range: %K is that position smoothed over 1 bars, and %D is a 3-bar mean of %K

indicators.label: ROC
indicators.gloss: the percentage change of the chosen price over the chosen number of bars (TradingView ta.roc)

indicators.label: Squeeze momentum (20)
indicators.gloss: LazyBear's squeeze momentum — the 20-bar linear regression end point of the close's distance from the average of the 20-bar Donchian midline and simple mean, in price units: the direction a TTM squeeze releases

indicators.label: CCI
indicators.gloss: the commodity channel index of the chosen price over the chosen number of bars: its distance from its mean in mean deviations, ±100 the usual bands (TradingView ta.cci)

indicators.label: Close change
indicators.gloss: the bar's own change, ((close − open) / open) × 100

indicators.label: Multi-timeframe change
indicators.gloss: the frame price against the open of each fixed horizon's bar in force at the frame's instant, read live

indicators.label: WaveTrend (10, 21)
indicators.gloss: the typical price's distance from its 10-period EMA channel in mean-deviation units, averaged over 21 bars; the signal is a 4-bar mean of that oscillator

indicators.label: QQE (14, 5, 4.236)
indicators.gloss: RSI (14) smoothed by a 5-period EMA, bracketed by a trailing stop set 4.236 × the smoothed RSI's average range away

indicators.label: Williams %R (14)
indicators.gloss: 14-period Williams %R — where the close sits in the 14-bar window ending at this bar, 0 at the high and −100 at the low

indicators.label: Stoch RSI (3, 3, 14, 14)
indicators.gloss: where RSI(14) sits in its own 14-bar range, 0–100: %K is that position smoothed over 3 bars, and %D is a 3-bar mean of %K
